narrationTexts: I'll start by searching for remaining `db.query` calls.
finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on all 12. No tests exist in the repo.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) | Header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it. |
| `cache.query` in 20 repo files | Different object. Not part of this move. |

Next: decide the vendor call. Pin the old `query` shim or wrap the adapter.
